page.text: Keep the six kingdom cards and your chart from Monday: they are your study sheet for the map quiz and for Quiz 1. Keep at the Spain map: regions, cities, waters, with the blank map and the Map Trainer on this site.

page.label: Monday, September 21
page.text: Map quiz on Spain: regions, cities, waters. The blank map is the whole plan.

page.label: Build a Guild
page.text: Three guilds formed Thursday, September 10: fishmongers, blacksmiths, and bakers. Keep your charter answers from class. Each guild will write out a full charter in its best calligraphy and bring in a masterwork of its trade. The dates will be posted here and in Educate.

glance.text: map quiz on Spain; keep at the blank map.
charter and masterwork dates to come.

page.label: Due Friday, September 18
page.text: Read and annotate Matthew 18:1 to 35, the whole chapter.

page.label: Due Friday, September 18
page.text: Read and annotate Cantos XVI and XVII. Write one discussion question that names a line (canto and line number) and bring it on paper to the door Friday. Two places worth a question: Geryon, the face of fraud (XVII.1 to 27), and the usurers who cannot look up (XVII.43 to 78). Thursday's class is the reading day for it.

page.label: Tuesday, September 22
page.text: Dante is Everywhere. Find a published poem on one Dante theme: sin, desire, freedom, courage, mentorship, or love of place. Bring it on paper. You present it in about three minutes: read it aloud, say what it means, name one trope (a figure of speech, such as a simile or a metaphor), and name the link to Dante. The poems moved here from Thursday, September 17.

page.label: Super Simile
page.text: Paragraphs 1 and 2 (the Charon birds, the Harpies) are in your folder. The folder stays in the room.
